_description: LiPo battery electrochemical model: terminal voltage, SoC, Peukert degradation, thermal, and usable energy equations.

equations.name: Terminal Voltage (Thevenin equivalent)
equations.description: Battery terminal voltage under load. V_OCV is open-circuit voltage (function of SoC). R_int is internal resistance (function of SoC and temperature). Voltage sags under high current.

V_OCV.name: Open circuit voltage
V_OCV.notes: Function of SoC. Lookup from OCV-SoC curve [FIG-6.2]

R_int.name: Internal resistance
R_int.notes: Function of SoC and temperature. Increases at low SoC and low temperature.

OCV_model.description: Polynomial fit to measured OCV-SoC curve
OCV_model.python: V_OCV = a5*SoC**5 + a4*SoC**4 + a3*SoC**3 + a2*SoC**2 + a1*SoC + a0

reference.text: Doyle, Fuller, Newman — J. Electrochemical Society, 140(6), 1993

validation.cross_check: At I=0 (no load), V_t = V_OCV — verified by open-circuit measurement

equations.name: State of Charge — Coulomb Counting
equations.description: Tracks SoC by integrating current over time (coulomb counting). Standard method for real-time SoC estimation in BMS.

Q_rated.name: Rated battery capacity
Q_rated.notes: At standard discharge rate (1C). For GARUN: 50 Ah = 180,000 A·s

dt_s.name: Time step
dt_s.notes: Simulation step size: 1 s for GARUN

limitations: Accumulates error over time without recalibration
Q_rated at C-rate differs from rated capacity (see Peukert EQ-BATT-03)

discretised_form.notes: Euler forward integration. dt = 1 s gives <0.01% error per step.

reference.text: Plett, G.L. — Battery Management Systems Vol.1, §3.3. Artech House, 2015.

test_case.notes: All-electric loiter: P=22kW, V_t≈400V, I=55A. Duration 5hr.

equations.name: Peukert Equation — Capacity Correction
equations.description: Accounts for capacity reduction at high discharge rates. At high current, electrochemical kinetics and diffusion limit available capacity below rated value. Critical for sizing battery for peak-power events (takeoff, climb).

n.name: Peukert exponent
n.notes: LiPo: 1.05–1.12. Lower = less capacity loss at high rate.

reference.text: Peukert, W. (1897). Über die Abhängigkeit der Kapazität von der Entladestromstärke. ETZ, 18, 287–288.

validation.physical_check: As I_actual → I_rated, C_actual → C_rated. As n → 1, Peukert effect disappears.

equations.name: Usable Battery Energy
equations.description: Total energy the battery can actually deliver on this mission, accounting for SoC window, Peukert degradation, and coulombic efficiency.

reference.text: Lukic et al. — IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 2008

equations.name: Battery Heat Generation (Joule heating)
equations.description: Resistive heat generated inside battery during discharge/charge. Drives battery thermal management sizing.

R_int.name: Internal resistance
R_int.notes: Total pack resistance. For GARUN: 0.012 Ω (12 mΩ)

reference.text: Joule's First Law. Bernardi et al. — J. Electrochemical Society, 132(1), 1985

test_case.notes: Loiter phase: P=22kW/400V=55A. Q_batt = 55² × 0.012 = 36.3 W (corrected from V_t)

equations.name: Battery Power Output
equations.description: Instantaneous power delivered by battery to DC bus. Equals motor demand divided by inverter efficiency. Links battery model to power electronics model.

reference.text: Khaligh & Li — IEEE Trans. Vehicular Technology, 2010
